XC.name: Wales
XC._comment: Wales (GB-WLS in ISO 3166-2) participated in Junior Eurovision in 2018 and 2019, and required a two-letter code for consistency with other participants. For this purpose, XC was chosen as its alpha-2 code, based on the endonym Cymru. This code replaces WA, which did not respect the user-assigned code space.

XW.name: Rest of the World
XW._comment: Used to represent Rest of the World votes in Eurovision, starting from 2023. Non-participant, so in_esc is set to false.
